تستنجون (form X)
# تَسْتَنْجُونَ (tastanjūna) /tas.tan.d͡ʒuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْجَى (istanjā)
# تُسْتَنْجَوْنَ (tustanjawna) /tus.tan.d͡ʒaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْجَى (istanjā)
